name: MAG A550BN
description_1: The MAG A550BN provides players with a safe, reliable, and efficient entry-level power supply option. Its core features include 80 PLUS Bronze certification and DC-to-DC circuit design.
description_2: Equipped with a low-noise 120mm fan and various industrial-grade protection mechanisms (OCP, OVP, SCP, etc.) to ensure system stability.

name: MAG A650BN
description_1: A dependable power source for mainstream gaming systems. The 650W capacity offers more headroom for mid-range GPUs while maintaining 80 PLUS Bronze efficiency.
description_2: Features high-quality capacitors and a comprehensive 5-year warranty. The sleek black design and flat cables help with clean system aesthetics.

name: MAG A750BN PCIE5
description_1: One of the first entry-level units to support the PCIe 5.0 standard. Ready for next-gen graphics cards with an included native 16-pin connector.
description_2: Offers high reliability and performance for modern gamers. Built within a compact frame for easy installation in most chassis.

name: MAG A750GL PCIE5
description_1: Fully modular 80 PLUS Gold PSU designed for modern gaming builds. ATX 3.0 and PCIe 5.0 ready with a native 12VHPWR connector.
description_2: Compact size (140mm length) fits small cases easily. Yellow colored connector tips ensure a solid and visually-checked connection.

name: MAG A850GL PCIE5
description_1: High-wattage stability for powerful gaming rigs. The MAG A850GL provides efficient power delivery with Gold-rated certification and full modularity.
description_2: Equipped with a FDB fan for quiet operation and long lifespan. Designed to handle power spikes from the latest generation of GPUs.

name: MAG A1250GL PCIE5
description_1: Massive power output for extreme dual-GPU or high-end workstation builds. 1250W capacity ensures you never run out of headroom.
description_2: ATX 3.0 compliant for modern electrical signals and peaks. Features high-quality Japanese industrial-grade capacitors for total stability.

name: MEG Ai1300P PCIE5
description_1: The ultimate digital power supply from MSI. 80 PLUS Platinum certified with comprehensive software monitoring via MSI Center.
description_2: Features a specialized silent mode and precise voltage regulation. Native PCIe 5.0 support for the most demanding future-proof builds.
